prior_year_events.impact_description: Unusually active hurricane season translated into frequency of weather losses affecting underwriting results and reserves.

named_events.loss_description: Very unusual storm at start of 2021 calendar year contributing to severe weather losses.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2021 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 839.0m (closing 31 Dec 2020). Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates negligible net prior-year development (gross movement ~GBP 0.0m, i.e. effectively flat). Management note that prior years (notably 2019) were materially impacted by Covid-19 event cancellation losses and natural catastrophe weather activity, while underwriting actions and market rate improvements have reduced volatility. No quantified gross prior-year strengthening or release is reported in the movement notes or triangle for years up to 2019.
raw_causal_phrases: materially impacted by both Covid-19 losses (in our event cancellation business) and natural catastrophe losses.
unusually active North Atlantic Hurricane season with a record number of storms making US landfall.
we took the decision to strengthen our initial expected loss ratio on certain lines of business following the deterioration we experienced in 2019 on prior years.
our underlying attritional losses are developing within our expectations.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (claims outstanding closing 31 Dec 2020). Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (the 'Estimate of cumulative claims incurred' table) which shows effectively zero net movement for underwriting years up to 2019; no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' numeric sentence was found. There is a RITC reference (2017 & prior reinsured), but triangle presented four years of development; prior-year movement computed from that triangle. Gross premium mix pulled from the Segmental Analysis note (direct insurance categories plus consolidated 'Reinsurance acceptances'). Some parsing ambiguity in tables required inference of which column corresponds to 2021; confidence levels reflect that inference.
